n_a3bf2bf9f815d86e.name: Collect Airtable pages
n_a3bf2bf9f815d86e.source: export default function pages({records,offset,previous}){if(!Array.isArray(records))throw Error('Invalid records');const state=previous??{records:[],seen:[]};if(!Array.isArray(state.records)||!Array.isArray(state.seen))throw Error('Invalid pagination state');if(offset!==null&&(typeof offset!=='string'||!offset||state.seen.includes(offset)))throw Error('Repeated or invalid offset');return{state:{records:[...state.records,...records],seen:offset===null?state.seen:[...state.seen,offset]},offset:offset??'unused',more:offset!==null}}

n_4fcdd65d99fb6faa.name: Select the next email
n_4fcdd65d99fb6faa.source: export default function next({pageState,previous,result}){const s=previous??{index:0,records:pageState.records,checked:[]};if(!Array.isArray(s.records)||!Array.isArray(s.checked))throw Error('Invalid state');if(previous){const item=s.records[s.index];if(!result||typeof result.mx!=='boolean'||typeof result.email!=='string'||result.email.toLowerCase()!==item.fields.Email.toLowerCase())throw Error('Unconfirmed MX result');s.checked.push({id:item.id,mx:result.mx});s.index++}if(s.index===s.records.length)return{state:s,more:false,email:'unused@example.com'};const r=s.records[s.index],email=r?.fields?.Email;if(typeof r?.id!=='string'||!r.id||typeof email!=='string'||!email.trim())throw Error('Record needs ID and Email');return{state:s,more:true,email}}

n_d4ba0a3c2a83c244.name: Prepare the next update
n_d4ba0a3c2a83c244.source: export default function next({checkState,previous}){const i=previous?.index??0,rows=checkState.checked;if(!Array.isArray(rows)||!Number.isInteger(i)||i<0||i>rows.length)throw Error('Invalid update state');if(i===rows.length)return{state:{index:i},more:false,records:[{id:'unused',fields:{Valid:false}}]};const r=rows[i];return{state:{index:i+1},more:true,records:[{id:r.id,fields:{Valid:r.mx}}]}}
